entries.description: Started Session 1: registered session start, read guidance/spec/DW-13; beginning re-grounding of RibbonStructure models, NavigationGraphInputs.Ribbon wiring, USysRibbons schema-only extraction, and SwitchboardExporter row-read template.

Re-grounded all spec pointers (RibbonStructure models, NavigationGraphInputs.Ribbon wiring at NavigationGraphBuilder:94, USysRibbons schema-only confirmed via local ir/, SwitchboardExporter/SignatureDetector/StructureBuilder/BuildNavigationInputs templates). Did local Northwind harvest of real USysRibbons.RibbonXML (C:/temp, never committed): namespace is 2006/01 NOT 2009/07, with idMso built-ins, deep nesting (box/splitButton/menu), and a contextualTabs section. Ran cross-provider consensus (gpt-5-4+gemini-pro) on the model shape: both chose a faithful recursive tree; synthesized to Option 2 + per-node verbatim Attributes bag. Decision recorded in s1-ribbon-model-consensus.md.

Added RibbonSignatureDetector + RibbonExporter (shape-gated USysRibbons row-read, Category Navigation, mirrors SwitchboardExporter; USys* is not a system-object skip) writing raw/Navigation/ribbon-xml.json; registered in Pipeline.Default(). Solution builds green.

Extended RibbonStructure model to a faithful recursive tree (nullable Id/Label, IdMso, ControlType open-string, per-node verbatim Attributes bag, Children, ContextualTabSets, OnLoad, Name) per the consensus; added pure namespace-tolerant RibbonXmlParser (match by local name; 2006/01 + 2009/07) and pure RibbonStructureBuilder (deterministic single-ribbon selection + multiplicity/malformed signals).

Wired BuildNavigationInputs to load ribbon-xml.json -> RibbonStructureBuilder -> NavigationGraphInputs.Ribbon (with RIBBON_MULTIPLE_DEFINITIONS / RIBBON_XML_PARSE_FAILURE / RIBBON_LOAD_FAILURE diagnostics). NavigationGraphBuilder already threads Ribbon=inputs?.Ribbon.

Hermetic pins: RibbonXmlParserTests (13, hand-authored committed customUI fixture — nested tabs/groups, onAction + declarative + idMso built-ins, splitButton/menu nesting NOT flattened, contextualTabs, verbatim Attributes, 2006/01 + prefixed-2009/07 namespaces, empty->null + malformed->FormatException, determinism), RibbonStructureBuilderTests (5: shape-gated populated/null, multiplicity surfaces one + counts rest, malformed-row recorded), RibbonSignatureDetectorTests (7). Updated harvester-schema.v1.1.json RibbonStructure $def to the recursive shape (relaxed required Id/Label, added IdMso/ControlType/Attributes/Children/ContextualTabSets/RibbonAttribute/RibbonContextualTabSet defs; additionalProperties-tolerant -> backward-compatible, no envelope bump). Extended NorthwindLocalInvariantTests: asserts NavigationGraph.Ribbon populated (Name=Main, tHome/Home, idMso TabAddIns, contextualTabs, onActions cmdAbout_OnAction+ddMRU_OnAction) AND the ribbon-bearing manifest passes v1.1 schema validation. 940/940 hermetic Pipeline.Tests green; 7 detector + 39 nav-builder green.

Proved HHC golden byte-level neutral: CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests PASSED (shape-gated RibbonExporter writes nothing when no USysRibbons -> no new file, NavigationGraph.Ribbon stays null/omitted; git status on samples/GoldenOutput/HomeHealthCare clean). ManifestSchemaConformanceTests 5/5 green. Real Northwind ribbon validated locally (never committed). Swept spurious samples/*.accdb COM-timestamp diffs.

Cross-provider routed verification (gpt-5-4) over 3 rounds: R1 ISSUES_FOUND (4) -> R3 VERIFIED. Disposition: Issue 3 (determinism tie-break) ACCEPTED+FIXED (RibbonXml final ordinal tiebreaker in builder+exporter, pinned); Issue 1 (empty->null attrs) REJECTED as misread (present-empty preserved distinct from absent, pinned); Issue 2 (unmodeled customUI sections) PARTIAL ACCEPT -> documented structured-view boundary + lossless raw fallback + DW-20/DW-21 (no model expansion, lean/scope); Issue 4 (signature collision) REJECTED by-design (SwitchboardSignatureDetector precedent). Saved s1-verification.md (raw rounds), s1-issues.json, s1-in-ide-devils-advocate-prompt.md (user-run pair). 942 hermetic Pipeline + 7 detector green; model-consensus also routed (gpt-5-4+gemini-pro).

Staged + committing S1: RibbonExporter/RibbonSignatureDetector (COM shape-gated row-read), RibbonXmlParser/RibbonStructureBuilder/RibbonArtifact, extended RibbonStructure model, BuildNavigationInputs wiring, harvester-schema.v1.1 RibbonStructure def, hermetic pins + Northwind local invariant ext, DW-20/DW-21. HHC golden byte-neutral; samples/*.accdb swept.

Re-grounded S2: confirmed RibbonControl.OnAction + RibbonStructure.OnLoad carry callbacks (S1 output); studied NavigationGraphBuilder entry-point/switchboard precedent and ResolvedModule procedure-name resolution; verified baseline build green.

Cross-provider design consensus (gpt-5-4 + gemini-pro, architecture) on the ribbon entry-point model; both chose a dedicated NavigationGraph.RibbonEntryPoints collection (Option B) over extending the startup-roots EntryPoints; recorded in s2-ribbon-entry-point-consensus.md.

Implemented ribbon entry-point derivation: NavigationGraph.RibbonEntryPoints (nullable, omitted when no ribbon -> golden-neutral) + RibbonEntryPoint record + RibbonCallbackKind/RibbonCallbackResolution enums; NavigationGraphBuilder.BuildRibbonEntryPoints walks onLoad-first then DFS tabs/groups/controls/children/contextual sets and resolves callbacks name-only (case-insensitive) -> Resolved/Unresolved/Ambiguous (no guessed module); schema RibbonEntryPoint $def added (additive, optional).

Pinned with 10 hermetic NavigationGraphBuilderTests (resolved/unresolved/ambiguous/case-insensitive/onLoad-first/nested-DFS/contextual/empty-not-null/idMso/no-ribbon-null) and extended NorthwindLocalInvariantTests (Invariant 7: real onAction callbacks resolve, cmdAbout_OnAction -> modRibbonCallback). 952 Pipeline.Tests green.

HHC golden proven byte-level neutral by a fresh COM run (CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests PASSED) + NorthwindDevEdition validated locally (NorthwindLocalInvariantTests PASSED, never committed). Swept Access-mutated samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb; no zombie msaccess.

Closeout-grade cross-provider session-verification (gpt-5-4) with embedded S1 evidence -> VERIFIED (R1, no issues). Authored s2-set-wide-evaluation-prompt.md (in-IDE GPT+Gemini devil's-advocate, primary).

Routed next-session-set recommendation (gpt-5-4, summarization) -> consumer-driven-only STOP with pre-scoped bundles; DW-18 flagged as the golden-affecting one-to-watch. DW-13 discharged in deferred-work.md (CLOSED, retained); DW-20 narrowed (onLoad now resolved).
Set 016 complete (2/2): DW-13 closed both layers (ribbon structure S1 + ribbon entry points S2). Closeout artifacts written; set ready to close.
